# go-plus (trendvidia/go#41): the preferlinkext token is a message to
# cmd/link and must not be handed to the C linker that links _cgo_.o for
# cgo -dynimport. It is an empty file, which Apple's ld refuses from
# macOS 27 on; dynimport then failed and was skipped for every package
# that set the token.

[!cgo] skip

# -static is a compiler flag that triggers external linking
# (checkCompilerFlagsForInternalLink), so the package gets the token. It
# only reaches compile steps, where it is unused.
env CGO_CFLAGS='-O2 -g -static'
go build -a -x -o p$GOEXE .

# The token was written, cgo -dynimport ran, and the C link before it
# did not get the token.
stderr 'preferlinkext'
stderr '-dynimport'
! stderr '_cgo_\.o.*preferlinkext'

-- go.mod --
module example.com/p

go 1.27
-- p.go --
package main

// int f(void) { return 1; }
import "C"

func main() { println(C.f()) }
